facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health transitioned its HMIS to a unified DHIS2 in 2017 across all regions and programs, per the Ethiopian Journal of Health Development case study.
The Ethiopian Journal of Health Development case study says the Ministry of Health has used an HMIS since 2008 and moved to a unified DHIS2 in 2017 to integrate data across all regions and programs.

ETH.note: Document is not about consultation on a digital law or policy.
